scenes.title: Park Scene 4 — Social Play and Helping
scenes.brief: Social-play scene with pushing, building together, giving, tidying up and drinking water.
targetExamples: The child is pushing the swing.
The children are building a sandcastle.
The child is giving the ball.
The child is putting the toy away.
The child is drinking water.

scenes.title: Park Scene 5 — Big, Small and Counting
scenes.brief: Playground comparison scene focused on big/small, tall/long, colours and counting.
targetExamples: The slide is tall.
The ball is big.
The scooter is small.
There are three yellow buckets.
The bench is long.

scenes.title: Park Scene 6 — Playground Routines and Positions
scenes.brief: Routine and position scene with helmet, backpack, bottle, ball, cones, scooter and slide.
targetExamples: The child is wearing a helmet.
The backpack is in the basket.
The water bottle is under the bench.
The ball is between the cones.
The child is behind the slide.

scenes.brief: Five playground children each showing one clear action: sliding, swinging, kicking a ball, riding a scooter and climbing.
targetExamples: The child is sliding.
The child is swinging.
The child is kicking the ball.
The child is riding a scooter.
The child is climbing.

scenes.brief: Six spatial relationships in a playground scene: under, on, above, behind, next to and near.
targetExamples: The backpack is under the bench.
The hat is on the bench.
The kite is above the tree.
The child is behind the slide.
The scooter is next to the sandbox.
The child is near the swing.

scenes.brief: Everyday playground task and social-language scene: giving, sharing, tidying up, using the bin, drinking water.
targetExamples: The child is giving the ball.
The children are sharing.
The child is putting the toy away.
The child is throwing the rubbish in the bin.
The child is drinking water.
